turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Can you confirm the refund has been issued?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great question! Let me check that for you. Yes, that's correct.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: How long will the refund take?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I understand. Someone from our team will follow up to confirm the details.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Of course. One moment please. Yes, that works.

turns.text: You're welcome! Have a wonderful day. Goodbye!
